chunks: This is the truth from your Lord, so do not be in doubt.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about being certain in faith and avoiding doubt?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the event of Mubahala, where the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) invited the Christians of Najran to invoke God's curse upon the liars, affirming the truth of his message. It underscores the necessity of unwavering certainty (yaqeen) in divine guidance, contrasting the clarity of revelation with the hesitation of those who doubt. This serves as a foundational principle for accepting the Imams' authority as the continuation of that divine truth.
